```artifact
Feature: Admin Management

  Scenario: Admin can add labs and chemists into the system
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin adds a new lab with name "Lab 1" and address "123 Main St"
    And the admin adds a new chemist with name "Chemist 1" and email "chemist1@example.com"
    Then the lab and chemist are listed in the system

  Scenario: Admin can update doctor information
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin updates a doctor's name to "Dr. Smith" and specialty to "Cardiology"
    Then the doctor's information is updated in the system

  Scenario: Admin can add a new speciality
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin adds a new speciality with name "Neurology"
    Then the speciality is listed in the system

  Scenario: Admin can view and update speciality details
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin views a speciality with name "Cardiology"
    And the admin updates the speciality's name to "Cardiovascular Medicine"
    Then the speciality's information is updated in the system

  Scenario: Admin can delete a speciality
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin deletes a speciality with no doctors attached
    Then the speciality is removed from the system

  Scenario: Admin can add a doctor to a speciality
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin adds a doctor to a speciality with name "Cardiology"
    Then the doctor is associated with the speciality

  Scenario Outline: Admin can add multiple doctors to a speciality
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin adds <num_doctors> doctors to a speciality with name "Cardiology"
    Then the doctors are associated with the speciality
    Examples:
      | num_doctors |
      | 1           |
      | 5           |
      | 10          |

  Scenario Outline: Admin can add doctors to multiple specialities
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin adds a doctor to specialities with names "Cardiology" and "Neurology"
    Then the doctor is associated with both specialities
    Examples:
      | speciality1 | speciality2 |
      | Cardiology  | Neurology   |
      | Neurology    | Cardiology  |
```
